Nvidia Board Faces a Governance Reckoning
items.d: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg opinion columnist Gautam Mukunda tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia has exposed broader corporate governance problems, as the board faces outside pressure to bring him back while investigations and potential shareholder litigation loom. NVIDIA says Jensen Huang will not return as CEO
items.d: On an earnings call announcing blockbuster revenue, the chipmaker’s Board Chair said Jensen Huang would not be reinstated as CEO. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.
